//! The published limit: an alias is a path whose owning segment is the
//! alias name, and the needle set is closed, so this is GREEN.

type Clock = std::time::SystemTime;

fn base_s() -> i64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}

fn a_case() -> i64 {
    Clock::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}
